**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes

[Appetizer]{.badge .badge-apps} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*A family favorite enjoyed by those that like spice.*

## Ingredients

- 1 can diced tomatoes
- ½ onion
- 3 jalapeños
- 1 bunch cilantro
- 1 lemon (juice)
- 2 tsp garlic salt
- 1 tsp cumin
- ½ tsp cayenne pepper
- back pepper (to taste)

## Instructions

1. Cut the onions and jalapeños into large chunks and place into a food processor.
2. Add the rest of the ingredients.
3. Blend to desired consistency.
